 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. According to UFC bantamweight champion Merab Dvalishvili , he and a friend allegedly were bloodied by PFL champ Usman Nurmagomedov and "so many guys" in a sneak attack.
 The incident occurred Wednesday while, according to Dvalishvili, he was conducting an interview in a hotel lobby ahead of RAF Abu Dhabi. Dvalishvili delivered a fiery response to Nurmagomedov while being tended to in a video posted on his Instagram .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "Usman Nurmagomedov and his friends came like snakes from behind!" Dvalishvili said, looking straight into his phone's camera. "What kind of fighters you guys are?! What kind of man does this?! If you want to fight, let's do like real way, bro! You guys came just because there's two of us, and you guys were prepared, bro! What the f*ck?! … That shows your guys' character, shows you're not real men! If you want to fight, let's f*cking fight!"
